title: Canopy Architecture and Training Biology
visualStandard: Mechanism-first educational visuals. No decorative stock-style plant art. Show measurable structure, light distribution, airflow, wound/recovery response, or source-sink consequences.

lessons.visual: Apical dominance diagram showing shoot apex, axillary buds, auxin-associated control, and branching response after apex loss
Side-by-side cannabis architecture plate comparing genetically compact, intermediate, and elongated branching forms under matched environment
Node-age and stem-flexibility training sequence with recovery checkpoints rather than calendar-week labels
Bending-response decision tree separating elastic bend, persistent lean, tissue crease, split, and recovery monitoring
Topping anatomy plate showing removed shoot meristem, retained nodes, axillary buds, wound zone, and subsequent branch redistribution
FIM-style cut variability diagram showing incomplete meristem removal and multiple plausible regrowth outcomes
Repeated structural-training timeline with symmetry targets, recovery intervals, and accumulated wound sites
Trellis canopy cross-section with support plane, branch positions, PPFD sampling points, and airflow paths
Lower-shoot pruning source-sink diagram comparing retained shaded sinks versus selectively removed lower growth
Defoliation tradeoff graphic showing leaf-area loss, internal light increase, airflow change, source capacity, and recovery checkpoints
